newsitem.title: UK: Glaxo gets vaccine licence from Cantab.
newsitem.headline: Glaxo gets vaccine licence from Cantab.

text.p: British drug giant Glaxo Wellcome Plc said on Tuesday it had agreed with Cantab Pharmaceuticals Plc for the worldwide rights to develop and market Cantab's proprietary vaccine, DISC, HSV.
The DISC HSV vaccine is for herpes simplex virus infections.

Cantab will receive 11 million stg in upfront payments, comprising a license fee of five million and equity investment of six million for 621,762 new ordinary shares, which represent around four percent of Cantab's enlarged share capital.
It will also receive further payments subject to the successful completion of development milestones and will also get royalties based on sales.
